title: Information Technology (IT) Support Apprentice
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Information Technology (IT) Support Apprentice Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Demonstrate effective communication and problem-solving skills by actively listening, asking clarifying questions, and utilizing critical thinking to provide clear, solution-oriented support tailored to user needs in various IT support scenarios.
Explain foundational IT support concepts related to setting up and managing computer systems, networks, and user accounts in a professional environment.
Develop and utilize technical documentation for troubleshooting, setup procedures, and IT support processes to ensure consistent and efficient user assistance.
Identify and analyze common IT issues to accurately diagnose, document, and communicate resolutions in a manner that aligns with industry best practices.

notes: The 'Prerequisite' block (CIS71, CIS103) is printed inside the program requirements and counted in the 22-25 credit total, so it is recorded as a required block.
The second 'Required' block (3-4 credits) lists CIS15 and CIS194; the program map says 'Take one of the following', so it is recorded as choose 1 course.

CIS99 (CIS Internships/Work Experience, 1-3 units) is not in the closed list; recorded as catalog addition. The program map schedules CIS99 in two different semesters, but the requirements list it once at 1-3 credits within the 11-13 credit block.
Catalog prints CIS103 at 4 units; the state file stores no units for it.
Catalog codes are printed without a space (e.g., CIS71); matched to closed-list codes with a space (CIS 71).
